cost_policy: free-first; no paid services, provider keys or cloud compute used
public_repo_rule: Safe for inkognitroz.github.io: no secrets, tokens, provider keys, raw prompts or private node data.
method: Deterministic DOM, CSS and action-path checks for the first screen, chat composer, compact model-picker handoff, model-library fallback, no-model fallback and mobile layout.

browser_attempt.result: Local browser inspection was attempted; deterministic CI checks remain the release gate for this slice.

checks: First screen keeps MMIR identity, Ground Zero card, composer, quick actions and demo path before secondary panels.
Composer has stable width, fixed send control dimensions and a model-connect handoff.
Connect/Add model prioritizes the compact model picker and keeps the model library as fallback instead of a dead configuration stop.
Top navigation stays horizontally reachable instead of disappearing.
Composer, quick actions, instant-start card and readiness rail stack without text truncation.
Runtime dock and model chips wrap to full width on small screens.

critical_paths.evidence: mimir-prompt, primary-chat-link, composer dock, model chip and CPU/RAM chip are present and mobile-safe.
new-backend and composer-add-model prepare the free local profile, open the compact model picker when loaded, and fall back to model-library.
Try demo mode has a first-click deferred loader handoff.
model-library-grid exists, recommended starter cards are styled, and starter focus actions are wired.
Mobile media rules stack instant-start, readiness, composer, runtime dock, model library and quick actions.
No-model visual report covers desktop and mobile route floor, first-chat fallback and progress fixture selectors.

critical_paths.id: D214 composer action bar visual QA
critical_paths.evidence: Composer action bar visual report covers desktop/mobile control wrapping, feedback readability, clickable resource chip and stable send control.
Plus opens a compact Open WebUI-style tools drawer for model, node, knowledge, new chat, voice and settings actions with mobile-safe wrapping.

critical_paths.id: D289 composer quick Chat now status
critical_paths.evidence: Clean first paint keeps only the subtle plus entry visible; the drawer shows Ready now, selected route, no-paid-route boundary and a primary Chat now action before setup-oriented tools.

critical_paths.id: D290 composer quick free route strip
critical_paths.evidence: The plus drawer now exposes three compact no-spend route chips for MMIR Guide, Browser WebGPU and Qwen3 local install, with one-column mobile stacking and no first-paint control noise.

critical_paths.id: D291 composer quick route click fixture
critical_paths.evidence: A dependency-free DOM fixture clicks all three quick route chips and proves prompt seeding, starter handoff, send click, installer resume and no-spend/no-secret boundaries.
Free API/local defaults stay first-paint critical through backend-profiles-critical.js while the heavier backend settings UI is deferred to keep chat fast.
The owner progress dashboard now renders only the first 72 backlog items by default, exposes Show all for the full queue and debounces search so the chat-first page stays responsive.
The first-paint composer now shows a compact plus and circular arrow send affordance, with runtime CSS/JS hiding the fallback plus after the richer dock is installed.
Critical runtime CSS now shows the composer dock with only #composer-add-model before chat, so the plus does not depend on deferred quick-actions CSS timing.
Runtime model-helper and installer-status styling now loads as deferred CSS, keeping the first chat shell under the tighter blocking CSS guard while preserving plus/tools visibility.
The static first-paint Send control records an immediate click and chat-runtime replays it through the automatic free route once event handlers are ready.

critical_paths.id: D298 startup free LLM node rail
critical_paths.evidence: The active-node rail now exposes every free browser/helper/WebGPU/Ollama starter from the catalog and carries selected local models into the universal installer handoff.

critical_paths.id: D299 startup free LLM click fixture
critical_paths.evidence: A dependency-free DOM fixture clicks startup MMIR Guide, Browser WebGPU and Qwen3 Ollama starters, proving first-chat send or selected-model installer resume without paid routes, secrets or raw prompt/response storage.
Unsupported WebGPU starter buttons show setup state and route to a useful MMIR Guide answer that explains the no-cost WebGPU or Local Node path instead of presenting the browser LLM as live.

critical_paths.id: D301 active node style headroom split
critical_paths.evidence: The active-node rail keeps only minimal first-paint layout in JavaScript while deferred runtime CSS owns the polished badges, setup-state chips, cards and mobile adjustments.

critical_paths.id: D303 expanded free node and LLM catalog
critical_paths.evidence: The active-node rail now includes local OpenAI-compatible LM Studio, llama.cpp and vLLM adapters, plus the startup model picker has at least 28 no-spend chat starters before paid/provider routes.
LM Studio, llama.cpp and vLLM clicks now activate the local OpenAI-compatible profile, hand off to chat-runtime, refresh /v1/models and send only after a real local model is visible.
Windows install/start copy and local-node installer tests now prefer npm.cmd, preventing the common npm.ps1 PowerShell execution-policy stop during local-node setup.

The local connector card now checks only the fixed localhost node path, remembers successful local proof with a time-limited secret-free marker and can auto-refresh known local models on later visits.

critical_paths.id: D307 live local model chat start
critical_paths.evidence: A connector event with a live Local Node model now promotes that model in the active chat route and routes the Local Node button through refresh/send before exactly one first chat send.

critical_paths.id: D308 quick actions live local route
critical_paths.evidence: The plus drawer Local chip now changes from Install local to Local ready when Local Node reports a model, and the same chip starts local chat instead of reopening the installer.

critical_paths.id: D309 model picker live local recommendation
critical_paths.evidence: The compact model picker now recommends Local ready when Local Node reports a model and the DOM fixture proves it starts chat without reinstall redirect.
A degraded Local Node event with a live model now keeps the active route strip, plus drawer and model picker on private local chat instead of sending users back to installation.
The first-screen cockpit now treats a degraded Local Node event with visible models as ready, so the first impression agrees with the working chat route.
The plus drawer and compact model picker now show Local ready from trusted Local Node model presence even when status is missing or still checking.

critical_paths.id: D313 stale offline local model recovery
critical_paths.evidence: A fresh Local Node model list without status now clears stale offline state in chat controls, while explicit new offline/error states remain visible.

known_limitations: This slice proves layout and control-path safety from source; it does not replace future human visual screenshots.
Live model quality still depends on a paired local node or browser helper capability.
